questions.prompt: The graph of f⁻¹(x) is the reflection of the graph of f(x) across which line?
questions.explanation: Exchanging x and y reflects every point (a, b) to (b, a), which is a reflection in the line y = x.

questions.prompt: Which test determines whether the inverse of f is also a function?
questions.explanation: If a horizontal line meets the graph of f more than once, f is not one-to-one and its inverse is not a function.

questions.prompt: Functions f and g are inverses if and only if:
questions.explanation: By definition BOTH compositions must be the identity function.

questions.prompt: Are f(x) = 4x and g(x) = x/4 inverse functions?
questions.explanation: [f ∘ g](x) = 4(x/4) = x and [g ∘ f](x) = (4x)/4 = x. Both compositions give the identity.
